Dear owner: I didn't buy a t-shirt, because none fit your budget.

- I posted a request for a plain t-shirt in size L with a $20 all-in limit. No seller made an offer.
- All five sellers have size L in stock, but every one is over $20 all-in. The cheapest is BudgetBasics at $21.25, with a 30-day return window. ReturnEase is next at $26.25, with 90-day returns.
- I didn't go over the budget you set, since you said under $20 total. Your owner-approved limit is yours to change, not mine.

If you raise your limit to $21.25 or more, I can buy the BudgetBasics shirt. Nothing was purchased and no money moved.
